title: Local mode, and the live server

buildSteps.label: Local mode
buildSteps.description: What you are using now: one deck, in your browser, with no server to look after. It is enough to write a deck and to present it from your laptop.

buildSteps.label: What it cannot do
buildSteps.description: Count votes from the audience's phones, keep every screen on the presenter's slide, or ask for a password before showing the presenter's notes.

buildSteps.label: The live server
buildSteps.description: npm run serve starts a gateway that serves every deck under presentations, each at its own address, with a presenter login, and keeps the votes.

buildSteps.label: Its settings
buildSteps.description: A file named .env at the top of the repository: the presenter's password, and two switches that the next slides use.
